# 1 Samuel Chapter 2 -- The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 131v-133r | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/1SA_002_page_001.jpg, 1SA_002_page_002.jpg, 1SA_002_page_003.jpg

---

**2:1** And-prayed Hannah and-said, "My-heart exults in-YHWH, my-horn is-raised in-YHWH; my-mouth is-wide over my-enemies, for I-rejoice in-your-salvation.

**2:2** There-is-none holy like-YHWH, for there-is-none besides-you, and-there-is-no rock like-our-God.

**2:3** Do-not-multiply [to]-speak high, high [things]; let-arrogance go-out from-your-mouth, for a-God of-knowledges [is] YHWH, and-to-Him deeds are-measured.

**2:4** [The]-bow of-[the]-mighty-ones [is]-shattered, and-[the]-stumbling-ones are-girded [with]-strength.

**2:5** [The]-full-ones for-bread have-hired-themselves-out, and-[the]-hungry-ones have-ceased; until [the]-barren-one has-borne seven, and-[she]-abundant of-sons has-withered.

**2:6** YHWH puts-to-death and-makes-alive; He-brings-down to-Sheol and-brings-up.

**2:7** YHWH makes-poor and-makes-rich; He-brings-low, also He-lifts-up.

**2:8** He-raises from-[the]-dust [the]-poor, from-[the]-ash-heap He-lifts-up [the]-needy, to-seat [them] with nobles, and-a-throne of-glory He-causes-them-to-inherit. For to-YHWH [are the]-pillars of-[the]-earth, and-He-set upon-them [the]-world.

**2:9** [The]-feet of-His-faithful-ones [hasidim] He-guards, and-[the]-wicked-ones in-darkness are-silenced; for not by-strength shall-a-man prevail.

**2:10** YHWH -- they-shall-be-shattered, His-adversaries; against them in-the-heavens He-thunders. YHWH judges [the]-ends of-[the]-earth, and-He-gives strength to-His-king, and-raises [the]-horn of-His-anointed-one [meshiho]."

**2:11** And-went Elkanah to-Ramah, to his-house. And-the-lad was ministering [to] YHWH [before the]-face of-Eli the-priest.

**2:12** And-[the]-sons of-Eli [were] sons of-worthlessness [beliyyaal]; they-knew not YHWH.

**2:13** And-[the]-custom of-the-priests with the-people: every man sacrificing a-sacrifice, and-came [the]-servant of-the-priest as-the-flesh was-boiling, and-the-fork of-three-[teeth] in-his-hand.

**2:14** And-he-struck in-the-basin, or in-the-pot, or in-the-cauldron, or in-the-kettle; all that the-fork brought-up, the-priest took for-himself. Thus they-did to-all Israel, the-ones-coming there in-Shiloh.

**2:15** Also before they-would-burn the-fat, and-came [the]-servant of-the-priest and-said to-the-man who-was-sacrificing, "Give flesh to-roast for-the-priest, and-he-will-not take from-you flesh boiled, but raw."

**2:16** And-said to-him the-man, "Let-them-burn, let-them-burn first the-fat, and-[then]-take for-yourself as-[whatever] your-soul [nephesh] desires." And-he-said, "No, for now you-shall-give, and-if not, I-will-take by-force."

**2:17** And-was [the]-sin of-the-young-men very great [before the]-face of-YHWH, for the-men treated-with-contempt the-offering of-YHWH.

**2:18** And-Samuel [was]-ministering [before the]-face of-YHWH, a-lad girded [with]-an-ephod of-linen.

**2:19** And-a-robe small his-mother would-make for-him, and-she-brought-[it]-up to-him from-days to-days [i.e., yearly], in-her-coming-up with her-husband to-sacrifice the-sacrifice of-the-days.

**2:20** And-blessed Eli Elkanah and-his-wife, and-said, "May-YHWH-set for-you seed from this-woman, in-place-of the-loan which was-lent to-YHWH." And-they-went to-his-place.

**2:21** For visited YHWH Hannah, and-she-conceived and-bore three sons and-two daughters. And-grew the-lad Samuel with YHWH.

**2:22** And-Eli [was]-very old, and-he-heard all that his-sons were-doing to-all Israel, and-that they-were-lying-with the-women who-served [at the]-opening of-[the]-tent of-meeting.

**2:23** And-he-said to-them, "Why do-you-do like-these things which I [am]-hearing, your-evil deeds, from all this-people?

**2:24** No, my-sons, for not good [is] the-report which I [am]-hearing; [you are]-causing-to-transgress [the]-people of-YHWH.

**2:25** If sins a-man against-a-man, and-intercedes-for-him God; but-if against YHWH a-man sins, who will-intercede for-him?" And-they-did-not listen to-[the]-voice of-their-father, for YHWH desired to-put-them-to-death.

**2:26** And-the-lad Samuel [was]-going and-growing, and-[was]-good both with YHWH and-also with men.

**2:27** And-came a-man of-God to Eli, and-said to-him, "Thus says YHWH: 'Did-I-not-surely-reveal-myself to-[the]-house of-your-father in-their-being in-Egypt to-[the]-house of-Pharaoh?

**2:28** And-choosing him from-all [the]-tribes of-Israel to-me for-a-priest, to-go-up upon my-altar, to-burn incense, to-bear an-ephod before-me; and-I-gave to-[the]-house of-your-father all [the]-fire-offerings of-[the]-sons of-Israel.

**2:29** Why do-you-kick at-my-sacrifice and-at-my-offering which I-commanded, [in]-habitation? And-you-honor your-sons more-than-me, to-make-yourselves-fat from-[the]-first of-every offering of-Israel my-people.'

**2:30** Therefore -- [the]-utterance of-YHWH, God of-Israel -- 'saying I-said, your-house and-[the]-house of-your-father shall-walk before-me until forever.' But-now -- [the]-utterance of-YHWH -- 'far-be-it from-me, for [those]-honoring-me I-will-honor, and-[those]-despising-me shall-be-lightly-esteemed.

**2:31** Behold, days [are]-coming, and-I-will-cut-off your-arm and-[the]-arm of-[the]-house of-your-father, from-there-being an-old-man in-your-house.

**2:32** And-you-will-look [at the]-distress of-[the]-habitation in-all which He-does-good [to] Israel, and-there-will-not be an-old-man in-your-house all the-days.

**2:33** And-[the]-man [whom] I-will-not cut-off for-you from-upon my-altar [will be] to-consume your-eyes and-to-grieve your-soul [nephesh]; and-all [the]-increase of-your-house shall-die [as]-men.

**2:34** And-this to-you [is] the-sign which will-come upon your-two sons, upon Hophni and-Phinehas: in-one day they-shall-die, [the]-two of-them.

**2:35** And-I-will-raise-up for-myself a-priest faithful; as-[that]-which [is] in-my-heart and-in-my-soul [nephesh] he-will-do. And-I-will-build for-him a-house enduring, and-he-will-walk before my-anointed-one [meshihi] all the-days.

**2:36** And-it-will-be, every-one remaining in-your-house will-come to-bow-down to-him for-a-coin of-silver and-a-loaf of-bread, and-will-say, "Attach-me, please, to one of-the-priestly-offices, to-eat a-morsel of-bread."'"

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

1. **2:1 -- "My horn is raised"** (רָמָה קַרְנִי): The "horn" (qeren) is a symbol of strength and dignity throughout the Hebrew Bible. Hannah's song uses royal/military imagery that anticipates the monarchy.

2. **2:3 -- "a God of knowledges"** (אֵל דֵּעוֹת): The plural דֵּעוֹת ("knowledges") is a plural of majesty or fullness. The Leningrad Codex preserves this form clearly.

3. **2:5 -- "the hungry ones have ceased"** (חָדֵלּוּ): The verb חדל means "to cease, desist." The sense is that the hungry have ceased [being hungry], i.e., they hunger no more.

4. **2:10 -- meshiho** (מְשִׁיחוֹ): "His anointed one" -- this is the first occurrence of the term "messiah" in Samuel. Hannah's song anticipates the kingship theme of the entire book. EMET transliterates this theologically loaded term alongside the translation.

5. **2:16 -- "let them burn, let them burn"**: The Leningrad Codex has the Hiphil infinitive absolute הַקְטֵר יַקְטִירוּן, an emphatic construction. The man insists the fat must be burned first per proper sacrificial procedure.

6. **2:22 -- "the women who served at the opening of the tent of meeting"**: The Leningrad Codex preserves this reading. Some scholars note this clause is absent from 4QSam-a, raising questions about whether it was a later addition harmonizing with Exodus 38:8.

7. **2:25 -- "for YHWH desired to put them to death"**: This theologically significant clause (כִּי חָפֵץ יְהוָה לַהֲמִיתָם) presents divine sovereignty alongside human responsibility. The sons' refusal to listen is explained by YHWH's prior determination.

8. **2:29 -- "in habitation"** (מָעוֹן): The Leningrad Codex reads מָעוֹן ("habitation/dwelling"). This has been variously interpreted. The Qere tradition and some versions read מְעוֹנִי ("my dwelling").

9. **2:33 -- "shall die as men"**: The Hebrew אֲנָשִׁים מֵתִים is difficult. It may mean "shall die in the prime of manhood" or "shall die as [grown] men" (i.e., not reaching old age).

10. **2:36 -- "a coin of silver"** (אֲגוֹרַת כֶּסֶף): The word אֲגוֹרָה appears only here in the Hebrew Bible. It denotes a small coin, emphasizing the degradation of Eli's priestly line.

-- EMET
